buildCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "preview" ]; then if [ -z "$DATABASE_URL_POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING" ]; then echo 'ERROR: DATABASE_URL_POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING is required for Vercel Preview migrations' >&2; exit 1; fi; export DATABASE_URL="$DATABASE_URL_POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING"; fi; if [ -n "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then npx prisma migrate deploy; fi && next build
